Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: Relied on a DuckDuckGo snippet that (incorrectly) stated Wikipedia said Mathilde Sophie died in Regensburg, without opening the article to verify. This introduced a wrong death place into the workflow and fostered confusion despite multiple other sources indicating Obermais (Meran/Merano), Tyrol, Austria-Hungary.
